title: weather
description: Sets the weather in the environment. See more in the [Popular Commands documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandspopularcommands#weather).

type.title: type
type.description: An `enum` of `clear`, `rain` (will cause snow in cold biomes), or `thunder` (will cause blizzard in cold biomes).

duration.title: duration
duration.description: An optional `integer` that will a random number between 300 and 900 seconds if not specified.
